question: Which celebrity announced a divorce in the strangest way possible?
story: Frankie Muniz announced his divorce with a dancing video, and the backlash made him delete it within hours. Yes, that Frankie Muniz. Malcolm in the Middle. The kid actor who grew up, became a race car driver, and honestly seems to be thriving. Early this month he shared that he and his wife Paige were separating after six years of marriage. But it was how he announced it that stopped everyone. Instead of a somber statement, the post reportedly featured a video of the two of them dancing together to an old two thousand eight pop song. People online did not know how to feel about it. According to reports, the criticism piled up fast, so he took the video down. His wife then commented that she was sorry he felt pressured to remove it, because people were being cruel. He later reposted a family photo, promising to co-parent as a team. Only Frankie Muniz could turn a breakup into a dance number.
